app.name: ShromikAI

hero.title: Your job contract, through the eyes of the law.
hero.description: Share your contract. In minutes, see where the risks are, which sections of the law they conflict with, and what to ask to change. Every legal citation is checked against the official source.
hero.scope: No guesswork. If we cannot verify it, we say: uncertain.
hero.sceneAlt: Floating glass contract sheets with unreadable lines of text, in soft light from above.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.intro: Two pictures and the principles behind them. Personal data is hidden on our own machine before anything reaches a cloud model.
architecture.containersDesc: The browser and API clients reach the backend. The backend uses the database, the local models and the PDF maker inside the private network, and sends only redacted text to cloud models.
architecture.pipelineDesc: Read the document, hide personal data, sort the clauses, find the laws and check the fixed limits, find the risks, check every citation, fix a failed one once, then write the answer. A step that fails stops the analysis.
architecture.principles: The principles and the verification rules, from the specification

security.title: Privacy and security
security.intro: The promises the system keeps and how each is enforced. The full text follows from the specification.

cards.noStorageBody: The text lives in memory for at most 30 minutes after the analysis. It is never written to the database, logs or files.
cards.redactedBody: Names, numbers and addresses are replaced on our own machine. If that cannot be done, the analysis stops and sends nothing.
cards.verifiedBody: A citation reaches you only after three checks. Otherwise the finding is marked uncertain and goes to a person.

story.privacyBody: Names, addresses, phone and national ID numbers are removed on our own server before the analysis starts. Your contract is not stored.
story.searchTitle: The relevant sections of the law, next to each clause
story.searchBody: Every clause is matched against a collection of the law taken from official sources; related sections come along with it.
story.verifyTitle: A citation appears only after three checks
story.verifyBody: A citation is shown only after three checks: the section exists, the quoted words match, and the section supports the claim.
story.inventedBody: A plain AI can name a section that is not in the law. Here every citation is checked against the law collection; one that does not match is not shown, and we say: uncertain.
story.illustration: This scene is a drawn illustration, not a measured result.
story.finaleBody: A PDF, photos or text. A camera photo is fine.
